Lines.en: It's time, it's time! It's FINALLY time!
Lines.zh: 是时候了，是时候了！终于是时候了！

Lines.en: You fool! While we travel around the timelines, I've been preparing my SECRET WEAPON!
Lines.zh: 愚蠢的玩家！我在穿梭时间线的时候准备了我的秘密武器！

Lines.en: Wahahaha! Let's see if you can handle......this!
Lines.zh: 哇哈哈哈哈！让我看看你能不能从我的秘密武器下活下来！

Lines.en: I've detected a strong breach in the timelime stability, User Dave......
Lines.zh: 我检测到时间线受到了巨大波动，用户戴夫……

Lines.en: No......no! I can't let you have that imitater!
Lines.zh: 不……不！我不能让你获得那个模仿者！

Lines.en: You are not getting the Imitater! You might have won, but I'll destory it as I escape!
Lines.zh: 我不会让你获得那个模仿者的！你或许能打败我，但是我能和你的随机模仿者同归于尽！

Lines.en: No, no! User Dave, he's contaminating our Imitater seeds! Do something!!!
Lines.zh: 不，不！用户戴夫！他在污染我们的模仿者种子包！快阻止他！！！

Lines.en: What a predictable creature! Get a chance!
Lines.zh: 真是一如所料！你们从一开始，就没有半点胜算！
